title: The Floating Axe Head
traveler_why: Wren is the Traveler who stops to wonder, and tonight's wonder is a heavy iron axe head floating up from the Jordan: Wren loses the cap of a borrowed marker, pauses, and whispers a tiny prayer about one tiny worry.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because she stops to wonder, and tonight’s wonder is a heavy iron axe head floating up. In Wren’s world today: she borrowed her friend’s blue marker, and now the cap is gone. Her tummy feels tight. Wren stops, folds her arms, and whispers a tiny prayer about one tiny cap. Then she looks again and finds it under the couch. Just like the man by the river with the borrowed axe, Wren learned that no worry is too small to tell Heavenly Father.
